remarks: Welcome to 7 Dogwood Lane, a truly turnkey ranch-style home nestled in the serene landscapes of Weston, CT. This charming 1,200+ sq ft residence offers 2 spacious bedrooms and 2 full baths, designed for comfortable and modern living.The allure of this property extends beyond the main home. A separate detached barn with additional garage space, storage and exercise area, also includes a loft that adds an additional 486 sq ft of heated living space, featuring a third bedroom-perfect for guests, a home office, or creative studio. Set on an expansive 3.35-acre lot, this property promises tranquility and privacy, surrounded by nature's beauty. Whether you're enjoying a morning coffee on the deck or exploring the lush grounds, this home offers a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle. Discover the perfect blend of rustic charm and contemporary amenities at 7 Dogwood Lane. Schedule your private showing today and experience all this unique property has to offer.
